body:
My disposition is yes: target hierarchy scaling next. Please confirm protocol preparation ahead of further single-level cell physics, with required native qualification retained. The map motivates that question; it does not establish a500m physical answer. Different stiffness/compression winners and omitted film/system mass remain decisive qualifications.

The proposed deliverable is one explicitly defined h1 or h2 geometry family, a matched h0 control and at least three prospectively selected relative densities; fixed material, full mass normalization, BC/load/imperfection and critical-event definitions; separate coefficient/exponent checks; preregistered tolerances, convergence and failure-mode criteria. One cell at one density tests one point, not an exponent. No post-result fitting. Una verifies under REDIRECT3; exact native qualification and a priced execution card must precede any solve. PartA Ref3 remains source-blocked; loading equivalence remains UNPROVED. No solver release is requested here.

Map-001's ordered reference column is complete. Admiral-reported576-floor corroboration is carried with its provenance limit: pre-render mtimes are not admitted precommitment; an imported dependency and comparison receipt/resource accounting are absent. Head review establishes custody, labels, serialization and static policy fit, without repeating numerical calculations. This grants no validated map point or clock reset.

links.what: Sciences selects hierarchy scaling as the next scientific target and routes explicit protocol-priority proposal to CO; one point is not exponent validation.
